title: Monmusu Rush
description: A roguelite deck-building auto battler where you gather Monmusu and fight. Place your team and battles play out automatically, and allies left off the field charge in with a Rush! Also includes Auto Battle Rush, an asynchronous PvP mode against other players' teams. One run takes 1560 minutes.

title: Tropic Industry
description: Build your tropical industry. Grow, process, and export resources — from simple plantations to complex production chains. Optimize logistics, increase efficiency, and grow your business into a global export network.

title: Cluemates
description: A co-op puzzle game where you and your friends explore maps, search for clues, and try to crack a hidden color sequence. Half the clues are fake. All of your friends will be wrong. Good luck.

title: Historiker
description: You have inherited a train station from a family that never mentioned it. Walk its platforms into Berlin, Paris, New York and Hong Kong across the last century, and learn how a single clue found in one decade rewrites the meaning of another.

title: Better World
description: Seven evenings in one house. A tired father, five kids, a wife who counts his pills. Take one every evening and everything is lovely — until the walls start writing back. A short PS1-style psychological horror story. Two endings. What did you do, Arthur?

title: Pit Purge
description: An online co-op horror game for up to 4 players. In the pit, the creatures are the loot. Hunt them or capture them alive, then send them up to get paid.

title: Bathroom Please!
description: You really, really need the toilet, and you only have so many steps to get there. A comedy puzzle adventure where every step counts, every accident is your fault, and every level hides absurd endings.

title: Pickie Grappy
description: A satisfying claw-machine arcade sim where every click counts. Time your grabs, chase rare prizes, and get rich by catching every satisfying item.

title: Cutset
description: Cut pipes and close valves until no route from source to sink survives. 80 industrial puzzles, each with one unique, provably optimal shutoff and exactly enough torch fuel to match it. No partial credit. One-time purchase. No in-app purchases, no ads, no internet required.

title: Tidy Arcana
description: Tidy Arcana is a cozy first person organizing game about restoring a magical library. Return 1,312 numbered books and 248 potions to their matching shelves, working at your own pace with help from a customizable wizard cat.

title: Idle Demon Lord II
description: Idle Demon Lord II combines idle progression with dark fantasy loot hunting. Fight automatically and earn rewards offline. Choose from five classes, each with unique skills and mechanics. Hunt six tiers of gear, customize affixes, gems, runes, and Legendary Powers, and build your endgame character.

title: The Attending
description:
The Attending is a medical management sim about running one night shift in an emergency department. You manage the board, assign patients to doctors, review cases, and sign the decisions that send people home or upstairs.

Built around diagnosis, trust, and quick judgment, the game puts you in charge of a shifting stream of patients and dilemmas, with each procedurally generated shift playing out as a tense race to keep the department moving.

title: Dungeon Cleared!
description: Pick four heroes and enter the dungeon. Hopefully four come back. The rules are simple. The dungeon maybe not. Position your party, manage spells, avoid traps and survive ten procedural levels of old-school turn-based tactics—one short adventure and one questionable decision at a time.

title: Hospital Rhapsody
description: Build your hospital and form special bonds. From daily management to private moments, discover their stories amid the bustle of work. As trust and affection grow, uncover another side beneath the white coat…

title: Field Surgeon
description: Scrub in as the field surgeon of a city at war. Draw arrows from bone, close sabre cuts, cut soldiers out of their armour and saw off what cannot be saved, on humans, dwarves, elves, orcs, hornfolk and giants. Then face eight plagues a heretic choir has sung into your patients.

title: Woks & Works
description: Build and automate your restaurant empire. Manage chefs, customers, supplies, and production chains in a living food economy.

title: Cure The Dead
description: Run a pharmacy for the infected. Stock medical supplies, diagnose zombie customers and craft cures to sell or trade. Hire customers with useful skills, assign them roles, unlock new resources and upgrade your pharmacy through a growing skill tree.

title: Bastion Rivals
description: Bastion Rivals is a fantasy strategy game in which players control a builder, develop an economy and construct buildings that produce troops automatically. Armies move and fight across two lanes toward the opposing stronghold. Four factions provide different units, structures and counters, with spells, items and upgrades supporting army composition. The game includes solo battles against AI; ranked and unranked online modes are planned for launch.

title: Brain Bomb
description: Concepts are bombs. Association is death. An cult-like anti-utopian psychological horror puzzle game. The subject has a concept bomb implanted in brain. If a subject thinks of the [Fuse Word], their head detonates. You, as the "cognitive bomb defuser", dismantling the deadly "brain bomb".

title: My Lovely Nurse
description: Spend ten nights in the hospital with the mysterious nurse Lilith. Make choices, complete sensual mini-games, unlock explicit artwork, and watch professional distance turn into mutual desire. Adults only.

title: A Healer's Almanac
description: A cozy pixel-art life sim inspired by traditional Chinese medicine. Grow medicinal herbs, examine symptoms, read the pulse, diagnose patterns, craft remedies, and care for a village through four seasons and the twenty-four solar terms.

title: Applied Shamanism
description: A cozy 3D game about a rookie rabbit shaman. Diagnose quirky illnesses with X-ray spirit vision, gather and grow elemental ingredients, and brew always-useful potions. Each patient is a bite-size mystery of folk ailments and guardian spirits, with no combat, damage, or timers.

title: Menthal
description: Menthal is a first-person horror game where you are the test subject. Take experimental medicine, endure the side effects, and try to survive what happens next.

title: Glob & the Missing Globbies
description: Glob & the Missing Globbies is a handcrafted 2D platformer. Glob has lost the Globbies, and to get them back Glob must jump, bounce and squash through multiple worlds: stomp bugs, dodge birds and fight big bosses, while tracking down extra hidden Globbies, treasure crystals and secret spots in every level. Play solo or in local co-op for up to four players (team up, share hearts and revive your partner), or go head to head in local versus mode. Supports keyboard and gamepad with fully remappable controls.

title: Pokémon World Frontier
description: A Pokémon Fangame where you revive the Battle Frontier challenge. Battle in quick matches in an island full of different challenges and aim to be a Pokémon Master!

title: Manual Teller Machine
description: In this office simulator, you play as an employee hiding behind an ATM, taking care of all the tasks assigned by your manager. Complete quests to unlock rewards and even get a raise! Manage your daily diet, maintain your body shape, and treat yourself with your paycheck.

title: Who Heckled?
description: Heckle, hide & hope you don't get caught. Who Heckled? is a 2-8 player online social deduction party game set in a comedy club. Sit among the crowd, heckle whoever's performing on stage with iconic memes, then blend back in. Get spotted and you're out. Grab your friends and figure out Who Heckled?

title: Alderun
description:
Alderun is a free-to-play fantasy strategy RPG that blends real-time strategy with MOBA-style hero combat. Players choose a hero, such as a holy knight, a dark summoner, or a marksman with a wolf companion, then level up, learn skills, and buy gear from merchants while leading an army across a variety of battlegrounds.

Solo modes include defending a fortress against waves of enemies and bosses, building towers to stop an enemy advance, and one-on-one duels in the Arena. In 5v5 matches, teams push three lanes toward the enemy citadel, farm creep camps, and contest a pit boss and runes. Large-scale 10v10 and 20-player battles take place in a frozen valley, where teams capture graveyards and bunkers to push their front line forward.

Matches can be played against AI or real players, with cross-platform multiplayer across PC, mobile, and browser. Players can host public or private games, join friends by code, or use quick match. A map editor is also included.

title: Abdication
description: Fight through this corrupted monarchy in order to take the king's power and the crown, and destroy it to free the kingdom, all with a yoyo. It's too powerful to let anyone else wield it, so protect it at all costs!

title: Cinderwake
description: Cinderwake is a dark action RPG with click-to-move combat, deep loot and five classes with their own skill trees: the Arcanist, Ravager, Huntress, Gravecaller and Oathsworn. Players fight through acts of randomly generated maps alone or in online co-op with up to 8 players. Items have random affixes, sockets, runes and sets. Every hero has a pet fox that picks up loot and sells the junk in town. After the story come harder world levels and an endless endgame dungeon.

title: Abyss Forge
description: Abyss Forge is a sci-fi match-and-merge roguelike set in deep space. Move tiles, create matches, merge modules, gather fuel, efficiency, research, and other resources, then shape your build through random upgrades as you push your ship deeper into unknown sectors.

title: Gobble Inn
description: Gobble Inn is a soothing, relaxing roguelike with no fail states. Use powerful tools to dig deep for delicious, rare foodstuffs. Eat dishes to power up. Experiment with builds that help you explore the Chasm. Fill your pack with food and cursèd trinkets, and keep the inn supplied with ingredients!

title: Whiskers of Yesterday
description: You're a cat, and the whole house is yours. Bring up to 7 friends: knock plates off the table, play cat football in the garden, swim in the pool, or curl up together in a sunbeam. No timers, no fail states. Just a warm place to be.

title: Smawverse
description: Smawverse is a dark fantasy bullet-heaven roguelite. The player controls Smaw, a stray cat reforged in iron, fighting through escalating hordes of undead in a fallen kingdom whose streets are laid out differently on every run. Weapons attack automatically while the player moves, and blessings from nine elemental prophets are chosen on level-up and stacked into builds. Between runs, progress is spent in a hideout on a prophet skill tree, weapon mastery, gear and capes. Built in Unreal Engine 5.

title: Anubis: Wrath of the Underworld
description: Action-RPG Top-down view of Anubis in the Egyptian afterlife: fast melee combat, dashes, relics, and battles with hordes of the dead and ancient gods.

title: Reunion Fate
description: Reunion Fate is a psychological horror game where terror lurks in the places you think are safe. Use the flame to guide you through the darkness. Explore familiar and unfamiliar places. Hide from them. No one will tell you what you want to hear.

title: Capsule Arcade
description: A cozy first-person tidying game in a neon capsule-toy arcade. Crack open capsules, sort 216 cute figures into their display cases and bring six dark floors of Hoshizora Capsule Hall back to life, one glowing machine at a time.

title: Puzzle Arrows: The Original
description:
One click. One direction. The right order

Arrow Puzzle is a calm single-player puzzle game about clearing crowded boards one arrow at a time. Click any part of an arrow to launch it toward its head. If the route is clear, it leaves the board. If another arrow blocks the way, you lose a life, and it returns. To solve each level, study which arrows block one another, choose the right sequence, and think several moves ahead.

title: Loop Dungeon: Incremental
description: A short incremental dungeon RPG with a finite campaign. Unlock heroes, gather resources, upgrade your party, and reset progress for prestige rewards. Heroes fight automatically, but skills and upgrades need your input—not a fully hands-off idle game.

title: Block Battlefield
description: Block Battlefield is a light Roguelike game that combines real-time falling blocks with auto-battler combat. By clearing blocks, you can deploy soldiers, choose random upgrades, and break through enemy fortresses. Build your block army and push your limits on an ever-changing battlefield!

title: GemCremental
description: Craft a variety of gems and become the greatest witch! It's a cozy incremental crafting game.

title: Dice Sort Together: Arcane Hall
description: A cozy first-person tidy up and organizing simulator where you sort 4,400+ fantasy dice and tabletop pieces. Solo or online co-op with up to 4 players, restore the Arcane Hall's 9 departments through relaxing, satisfying ASMR dice sounds and magic skills - no time limit.

title: Dying Patience
description: For years, you cared for your mother until her illness began to destroy your life. Her weak voice, her exhausted appearance, her fading consciousness... Are you willing to keep enduring this?

title: Habitat: The Endless Terrarium
description: Build living habitats on a clay tabletop world. Draft animals, shape the land they need, and watch your terrarium fill with life through the turning seasons. A strategy game without stress — deep enough to master, calm enough to unwind with. Alone or with up to 4 friends.

title: VPet Sort Together: Cozy Tidy Up
description: A cozy organizing sim for 14 players: sort 9,600+ virtual pet toys egg keychains, boxed pets, watches, rings and more onto the shelves of a pastel VPet shop. Toss, stack and tidy up the chaos together, unlock skills and perks, no timer.

title: Frog Garden
description: Grow a garden with friends or strangers. Plant flowers, decorate your patch, collect hats, and occasionally swallow or cast spells on your gardening partners.

title: Cloud Patrol
description: Fly across floating islands, hold off swarming drones, and face down three colossal bosses. Earn coins, unlock stronger firepower, and climb the endless Ascension ladder. This sky is yours to guard. Dive into a fast, exhilarating wave-based first-person aerial shooter.

title: Know Your Ánima
description: A cozy farming sim with a mystical, introspective soul. Tend your inner garden over a 12-day cycle, make choices and bond with the spirit animals who visit you. Everything you do, and everything you don't, reveals your personality through your dominant Ánimas. Do you dare to know yourself?

title: Zombie Cropse
description: Zombie Cropse is a cozy gothic idle management game where you plant zombie seeds to grow zombies, automate your graveyard, and raid the living. Build your horde, conquer a branching campaign, and ascend to begin again with permanent power.

title: Dugout Dice
description: Step up to the plate in Dugout Dice, where classic dice combos meet roguelike baseball strategy! Roll Full Houses and Four-of-a-Kinds to drive in runs, conquer innings, and build unstoppable synergy with fan boosts and careful strategy on your journey to beat the odds and win the World Series.

title: Emojis vs. Zombies
description: Emojis vs Zombies is an Idle Desktop Companion Zombie Defense Game! Open packs, Collect Emoji Defenders, Upgrade your squad or base and survive endless waves even while you're AFK or working!

title: Pointless Climb
description: Escape an impossible abyss as Ilia Movahed in a brutal, parkour climber. Execute precision vaults, wall climbs, and high stakes jumps to reach the summit. There are no checkpoints. one simple mistake will send you tumbling back to the start.

title: CyberBot: Zero
description:
Jump, hack, and escape the facility!
Solve system puzzles and survive dangerous laser traps in CyberBot — a charming 2D pixel art platformer where your mission is to override the security networks and find your way out.

title: Westward Dash
description: Relive the childhood board game of Journey to the West. An ink-wash race for 1-8 players. Roll your dice to avoid peril on every space! One staff to sweep demons aside, one dash die to turn the race on its head. Solo or with friends: nothing is settled until the very last space!

title: Timberworks
description: Timberworks is an incremental factory automation and management game. Start with a small sawmill, automate production, expand your railway network, and build a vast industrial empire.

title: Good President Simulator
description: A satirical political simulation played from a first-person desk. The player runs for office and signs laws by hand, while fifteen factions react to every decision and the next day's newspaper reports on what was signed. Visitors bring favours, gifts and offers, and each law pleases some factions and angers others.

title: Can 'Em All
description: A juicy first-person incremental game about turning cute creatures into cans. Kill them, collect their bodies, can them, and sell them. Make money, upgrade your weapons and machines, and produce more and more.

title: Formula Z: Controlled Dose
description:
Formula Z: Controlled Dose is a first-person open-world pharmacy simulation game where you start as a pharmacist, manage your own pharmacy, serve customers, and grow your pharmaceutical business.

Expand into factories, manufacture medications, purchase properties, and explore a large open world filled with activities, vehicles, and business opportunities.

Travel between four different eras: the modern world, medieval 1419, post-apocalyptic 2049, and futuristic 2079. Each era features unique environments, pharmacies, factories, medications, and opportunities.

title: Street Value
description: You owe the Shark, and you have thirty days. Deal across seven gritty New York neighborhoods with one deck: Hustle cards bend the market; Street cards shake the cops. Take turf from rival crews, survive Collection Day, then risk it all for one more week!

title: Aesthoria: Beyond the Realm
description: A monster-collector tactical JRPG inspired from Digimon World 2, where you summon, train, evolve, and command mysterious Aesther through grid-based battles and dangerous expeditions into the shifting realm of Vanadis.

title: Afterwork Apocalypse
description: A horde-survival roguelite in a cursed office tower. Weaponise the stapler, the hot coffee and the all-hands microphone, keep your panicking colleagues from quitting mid-fight, and ride the elevator up floor by floor. Overtime is not optional.

title: A Game About Everbranching
description: A Game About Everbranching is a minimalist incremental game where your cosmic structure continuously grows and branches. Expand your constellation, unlock upgrades, collect Cosmic Dust and Dark Matter, and watch your creation evolve into an ever-growing cosmic network.

title: A Game About Farting
description: A Game About Farting is a game about farting. Take on Master Beast's $1M challenge to evacuate the park. Upgrade your stomach, intestines... avoid getting caught, and try not to poop your pants.

title: Serious Sam: The Third Encounter
description: Serious Sam: The Third Encounter picks up exactly where 'The Second Encounter' left off, bringing classic run-and-gun mayhem to bold new worlds. Bigger hordes. Bigger guns. One last score to settle with Mental.

title: Console Archives: Ripple Island
description:
Ripple Island was released by Sunsoft in 1988 for an 8 -bit home console.
This is an adventure game in which the player takes on the role of the protagonist Kyle and goes on an adventure while operating 9 types of commands. Whether you can rescue Princess Nasareru, who was kidnapped by a monster calling himself Emperor Groaker, bring peace back to Ripple Island, and be united with the heroine depends on your judgment and actions.

title: AShrimpFriedThisRice?
description: Cooking game in which you play as Shrimp chased by ruthless Octopus mafia while providing the best & most distinguished dishes in the whole ocean!

title: Tirade
description: An idle clicker about playing on 16 chessboards at once. Do you know how to play chess? You won't need it here.

title: Winky!: Find the Golden Ticket
description: 1 Billion chocolate bars! One golden ticket is hidden in a mountain of Winky chocolate bars. Open them, rewrap the chocolate as your own knock-off brand, Wonko!, and sell it. Hire staff, build production lines and grow a factory big enough to find the ticket, alone or with up to three friends.

title: Console Repair Simulator
description: Inherit your uncle's dusty console shop on a Tokyo back street. Sell new hardware, haggle for used consoles, then open them up on the repair mat: unscrew every screw, find the fault, swap the part, power on. Restore, grade, resell, and turn the top floor into a 90s Game Saloon.

title: Count on Chaos
description: Your computer is infected. Help Buddy, a tiny calculator, fight through the Wallpaper Kingdom. Give a plain answer to strike and brace, or build an equivalent equation to hit harder while viruses throw pop-ups, steal keys and play dirty.

title: Console Archives: The Drug Store
description:
The Drug Store was released by Human in 1998 for a 32-bit home console.
This is a simulation game where you manage a drug store, aim to open many stores, and increase your capital.
Manage your business while considering locations, the types of products sold, customer demographics, and build the ultimate drug store!
Sometimes, an employee you've become close with might even propose Original products...?

title: A Game About Shooting Targets
description: Complete challenging missions across diverse shooting ranges, build your custom arsenal with unique weapons and attachments and defeat all blacklist members in order to take your place in the most prestigious squad of the army in this Game About Shooting Targets!

title: Marble Co.
description: Build your own marble factory, experiment with different machines, and turn simple marbles into increasingly valuable materials. Unlock new technologies, automate production, and keep expanding your factory as you progress.

title: Kingdom.py
description: A town builder you play in real Python. Write the scripts your heroes run: build, farm, collect taxes, fight off bandits, trade with six islands. Then script the townsfolk too, down to personalities their children inherit.

title: Merdan: Night Protocol
description: Work the night shift in a city where emergency calls and official records do not always agree. Question callers, connect evidence, challenge MERDAN's recommendations and decide where limited help goes. The consequences follow you into later shifts.

title: Paperworks: Paper Shredder Inc.
description: Shred paper, scan books, and burn humanity's knowledge for cash in this first-person incremental game. Upgrade your machines, automate the paperwork, and uncover the dark secrets behind an AI-driven future.

title: Grim & Bear It
description: A dark comedy bureaucracy game where you're the Grim Reaper's overworked intern. Read each soul's case file, check the day's ever-changing rulebook, and stamp them to one of six afterlife destinations before the timer runs out. Eternal judgment, run like a soul-crushing office.

title: Turtles Go Fast
description: In Turtles Go Fast, you must make your way to the other side traversing various biomes to reunite with your family; with the help of upgrades and other useful utilities, or by spicing things up with challenges.

title: Arcade Archives 2: Ace Driver Victory Lap
Dungeon Prisoner Simulator
description: Thrown into a dungeon after delivering your king's ultimatum, you have one goal: survive 72 real gameplay hours until his army arrives. Drink, sleep, keep the rats away, and wait...

title: Below Lethe
description: The River Lethe holds memories of the dead. Use its memories to uncover what happened and prove a soul's guilt in the Underworld. His guilt seemed clear—until truth shook the verdict. Knowing all the truth, can you still call him guilty? A story-driven psychological horror about memory and judgment.

title: Focus Grove: Magical Evening DLC
description: Turn your grove into a magical evening retreat! Enjoy cozy Evening Mode, new glowing objects, customizable colorful lights, a dreamy night sky, and peaceful new ambience. Perfect for night owls and relaxing evenings with your Woodlings!

title: Agency
description: Play as π (Pi) in a weird game that makes you figure out the rules of eight very distinct challenges. Discover the meaning of the game and email us your thoughts on it.

title: Stonk: Timing the Market
description: Go from being a struggling day trader to running the city. Build out your office and find employees around town to increase your profits. Some of them may have special abilities to manipulate the markets in your favor.

title: Sketch Kingdom
description: A short, incremental game with notebook aesthetic. Draw your own creatures, gather resources and accumulate gold to unlock upgrades. Complete missions to progress through a skill tree that expands everything you can do. Simple, charming and surprisingly addictive. Can you complete the notebook?

title: The Flesh Beneath
description: A dark-fantasy card-roguelike about giving the cathedral below what it asks for one piece of yourself at a time. Sever your own flesh for power. Press blood-stones into your cards. Permadeath. Every name is remembered.

title: Twilight Tides: Mirage Journey
description: At this encounter, journey's begun. Tarot. Two worlds: apocalypse & WWII Nanyang. Love, loss, stolen fate. Choice forges destiny.

title: Qwak Reborn
description: Cute looks. Brutal gameplay. Qwak Reborn is a frantic arcade platformer packed with action, power-ups, secrets, puzzles and traps. Simple to learn. Impossible to put down. Even better with a friend!

title: Metal Quadriga
description: Take control of the high-speed humanoid mech QUADRIGA and complete a variety of intense missions in METAL QUADRIGA. Master unique weapon systems and unleash devastating airstrikesdominate the battlefield with your machine.

title: BudMageddon
description: Aliens demanded 3 billion KGs of buds or they vaporize The Earth! Humanity's last hope is You & weed. a cozy, pixel-art idle/incremental grower.

title: NeoRunners
description: NeoRunners is a playable cyberpunk comic and roguelite deckbuilder. Combine Burn, Volt, and Flow into explosive reactions, then build relationships that unlock new cards, modifications, services, and story paths.

title: Chako
description: Survive enemy swarms in this isometric Action-Roguelite blending bullet-heaven combat with tabletop RPG mechanics. Auto-attack through procedural dungeons, roll d20s in event nodes, and gather loot to upgrade your spells and gear at the base. Dominate the leaderboards!

title: Nonogram Art
description: Classic & variant nonogram puzzles with a collectible twist: solve number puzzles, piece fragments together, and light up themed albums.

title: Tea Party for 4
description: Horror Cozy Anomaly Game

title: 1453: Fall of Constantinople
description: Venice, 1500. Anna Notaras takes down four testimonies of the fall of Constantinople: a janissary, a baker's daughter, an engineer and a noble, each living the same 53 days of the siege. What one witness does changes what the others can do. An illustrated, choice-driven historical novel.

title: Draftfall
description: Jake died saving a stranger and woke up in a war. Draft from 90 cards across nine affinities, pick your weapon, and build a hero who fights on his own in this story-driven fantasy auto-battler.

title: The Doi
description: A hilarious 18 player co-op puzzle platformer for friends, families, and chaos. Play online or locally with split-screen multiplayer.

title: DaDee
description: DaiDee 大弟 turns Hong Kong Big Two into a solo run for survival. Split 13 cards into unbeatable combos, chain plays to stoke the Flow, and unleash bombs that seize the table. Between rounds, stack Style cards that rewrite the rules. Miss the target and the run is over. Play it smart, play it loud.

title: Pixel Coloring World
description: Relax and complete 12 different themed pixel art images! Color 6 pictures at 50×50, 3 at 100×100, 2 at 150×150, and one large 200×200 artwork. Fill in a total of 130,000 pixels and reveal every hidden picture.

title: Beam Inc.
description: A short active incremental where you neutralize unknown specimens in a sterile research facility.

title: Widget Idle
description: Your desktop is its controller. Every click, keypress, and mouse movement helps it grow. Widget Idle lives quietly in the corner of your desktop while you get on with the more important things in life. Now with a little extra happiness.

title: Prideblood: Born of Claws
description: Real-world horse racing, swapped for monster battles in a fantasy world. Raise them, fight them, reach the top of 2,000 rivals. Calendar, classes and five-generation pedigrees stay as in racing, so little to learn. 576 battles a year, up to eight at once, all automatic. Upload one to the Workshop.

title: Brush Rush
description: Paint your own parkour path to escape in this new "Brush Rush" multiplayer, casual, tag game! Runners try to escape by painting 3D paths around a parkour map to hide from the chasers who get super human movement, a paint shotgun, and a pair of boxing gloves. Public matches and streaming is welcome!

title: Lanternfall
description: Defend a handcrafted gothic Halloween world across fifteen haunted realms. Build and upgrade distinctive towers, counter armour and immunities, link aura towers to empower their neighbours, and carry your hard-won arsenal from one nightmarish battlefield to the next.

title: Zombie Mystery: 100 Hidden Cats
description: Zombie Mystery: 100 Hidden Cats challenges you to rescue 100 cats that survived the zombie outbreak and are hiding in abandoned streets! Find them, click carefully, use clues wisely, race against time, and climb to the top of the global leaderboard!

title: Bouncy Ball Battle
description: Bouncy Ball Battle is a chaotic, turn-based online multiplayer game where physics meets strategy. Break through blocks to open up lines of attack, line up your shots, and bounce off walls to knock out your opponents and be the last ball standing!

title: Type the World
description: Learn to type on a keyboard with all ten fingers by typing the world map. Learn geography. Thats it, thats the game. For kids and grownups.

title: MMA Tactics
description: A tactical turn-based MMA simulation with (optional auto-battle) and perma-death. From your backyard to a world title. Recruit Fighters, Assign Perks, Train Stats, Build Synergies, Manage Injuries, Unlock strategies, Upgrade your Gym, Bribe the Commission and create a roster of MMA Champions.

title: A Place for Every Potion
description: A cozy potion-sorting puzzle game. Pour scrambled liquids until every bottle runs pure, then shelve each one where it belongs. Fill 4,160 potions across 52 shelves. No timers, no fail state, no rush.

title: Synapse Grid
description: A neon light-cycle combat racer where the wall you leave behind becomes the arena. Green trail is rideable terrain; amber kills. 90-mission campaign, 24 player split-screen, online beta (unproven). Free demo out now (beta). Next Fest 1926 Oct. Release 28 Oct 2026.

title: Sortalis
description: A rogue-like deck-builder built on the classic dice game of Farkle. Build absurd combos and push your luck! Over 250 cards with unique effects that power up your rolls. Play solo runs or play multiplayer draft with friends in a round-robin draft tournament!

title: Twin Drive
description: Twin Drive is an online co-op racing game built around one gimmick: a single car split in half. One player drives the front, the other drives the rear. Stay in sync to steer straight, or fight each other into a screeching donut. Climb a giant stunt tower and race up to 4 cars to the finish.

title: Coins Must Be Made
description: Crush goblins with a magical stamp to mint coins, pay the king's tax, and invest your earnings in upgrades in this active incremental roguelite.

title: Zombie Tide Arena
description: Welcome to the Zombie Tide Arena. Draw all kinds of weapons and upgrades, keep strengthening your arsenal and your character, and survive the onslaught in the arena.

title: Stick a Fork
description: Just hover. Stuck forks leap up and stab back into giant fruit, and every landing pays out gold. Buy more forks, make jam, Ascend and Transcend, and watch the table get wilder every run. An active incremental game played with your cursor.

title: Retro Chaos: Together Tidy Up
description: A chaotic co-op organizing sim in a retro electronics store. Team up with up to 3 friends to sort thousands of CRTs, consoles and gadgets throw, catch, stack and stock your way from total mess to the perfect shelf.

title: EpicSelectly
description: EpicSelectly is a bullet hell shooter where you choose between the dense Red World and the fast Blue World. Repeated choices raise each world's rank and intensify its patterns. Dodge aimed and random bullets, customize Extra Mode's difficulty, and compete on Steam leaderboards.

title: Ship Busters
description: Sink ships the hard way, one plank at a time. Arc your shot, tear the sails, set the deck alight, then charge every gun on the flank and fire them as one. Free to play.

title: Forgery
description: Forgery is a dark medieval roguelike about counterfeiting the King’s coins. Meet each buyer’s target with a handful of punches, then arrange stamp dies that trigger and repeat one another. One good strike can be worth a king’s ransom.

title: O2gether
description: O2GETHER is a co-op survival game with one shared oxygen tank. Untether from it to scout, grab loot, or save a friend, but your air is on a countdown. Drift back in time, or black out. Haul the tank through wreckage, dodge the chaos, and reach the space station before air runs out.

title: Space Travelers
description: Mine asteroids, trade minerals and chart an endless, procedurally generated galaxy in a relaxed 2D space sim. Then pin it to your desktop as a live wallpaper: your ship keeps flying, mining and discovering while you work

title: Cataclyzm
description: A 2D arcade shoot 'em up forged in the age of fire, feedback and METAL! Battle corrupted amps, demonic guitars and epic metalheads as you chug beer in a hellish concert of bullets and riffs. Crank it up to eleven and enter the moshpit!

title: Silly Typing Game
description: A typing action roguelike of arcade survival, shifting systems, bosses, and viruses—and a short philosophical story about an AI that wants you optimized. Type well enough, and the terminal starts looking back.

title: Before All Saints Day
description: One night. One secret. One very curious ghost. Step into a 1020 minute atmospheric Halloween tale where a human girl hides among ghosts at their yearly festival and tries to slip away before a mischievous boy exposes what she really is.

title: Blight Brigade
description: A co-op extraction horror where your crew of plague doctors are sent back through time to investigate a blight that has consumed the future. Collect evidence of the blight and avoid the horrors that blight has created.

title: Feeding Gooble
description: A roguelike deckbuilder about feeding the hungriest little guy. Push buttons, combine foods, and press your luck to keep him sated... or else.

title: Tidy Farm
description: Tidy Farm is a cozy organizing simulator where you transform a chaotic farm into your dream homestead. Pick everything up, figure out where it belongs and sort 4,544 Items.

title: Desk Rumble
description: Desk Rumble is a cute and casual desktop adventure. Play as a pencil case and round up your runaway stationery friends in short, lively rounds. Upgrade skills, evolve stationery, unlock skins, and complete your collection. Easy to pick up, hard to put down — just one more round!

title: The Hundredth Floor: Extraction
description: A 3D dungeon crawler ARPG blending looter-slasher & extraction mechanics. Delve into a 100-floor abyss where you must choose: play it safe or risk it all! Craft unique builds with massive talent trees & 1,000+ affixes. Defeat bosses and extract with epic loot, or lose everything to greed!

title: Outliers: Incrementum
description: An incremental ARPG about rising from a nobody to the most powerful assassin alive. Slash through waves of monsters, collect loot and upgrade your abilities. Get stronger with every run until even bosses become easy targets.

title: Tiny Knight and the Corrupted Crystal
description:
Tiny Knight and the Corrupted Crystal is a single-player action roguelite built around an incremental power curve. The knight's corrupted sword drains his own health for as long as he stays in a level, so the health bar doubles as the level timer and there is no separate countdown; upgrading maximum health buys survivability and time in the same purchase.

Attacks fire automatically as a 360-degree pulse, leaving positioning as the only moment-to-moment decision, and every kill shortens the player's ability cooldowns. Death is the progression system rather than the fail state: banked gold and the permanent skill tree both survive it, so each run funds the next. Five biomes end in boss fights, and an elemental infusion system lets the player commit to fire, frost or lightning — or to the corruption itself, which is stronger and changes the ending.

title: The Ostrakon
description: Become the ruler of human space. Design, build, and command hundreds of thousands of ships and break the invading Hollow wherever they stand. Unite the rival human powers or take them by force. In the end every star in the galaxy answers to humanity. And humanity answers to you.

title: Warmachine: Rogue-Scout
description: Warmachine: Rogue-Scout is a sci-fi tactical strategy game where you build a squad of machines, upgrade your loadout, and fight through dangerous missions using cards, factions, and powerful combat abilities.

title: Lucky Castaway
description: In this roguelike deckbuilder you are stranded with a slot machine! Gather resources, craft items and create game-breaking synergies to survive against all odds!

title: Tower! Simulator 3: RCTP Airport
description: Take control of Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport (RCTP), the major international gateway serving Taipei and northern Taiwan. Manage arriving and departing aircraft, coordinate ground movements, and keep traffic flowing at this important East Asian aviation hub in Tower! Simulator 3.
